title: PBA: Ginebra secures playoff spot, sets up showdown vs San Miguel

blocks.text: ANTIPOLO—Barangay Ginebra secured the last quarterfinals berth in the 2026 PBA Governors’ Cup while setting up a best-of-five duel with San Miguel Beer after defeating Blackwater, 101-96, on Friday at Ynares Center here. There were hardly any complications as the Gin Kings took matters into their own hands right from the get-go to beat Bossing and finish with a 5-5 win-loss record to make the playoffs. Ginebra also got the No. 3 spot in Group B despite being tied with Phoenix by virtue of a tiebreaker. The quarterfinals start Sunday, but the Ginebra-San Miguel series tips off on Tuesday.
